/subscribed/subtitle.v: Onani bokosi lanu la imelo kuti mupeze imelo yotsimikizira.

/form/intro.v: Makope atsopano amabwera kudzera pa imelo, olembedwa m'chinenero chomwe mwasankha.

/form/nameHint.v: Timaligwiritsa ntchito kukupatsani moni. Mukalisiya lopanda kanthu, timagwiritsa ntchito chiyambi cha adilesi yanu ya imelo.

/form/languageHint.v: Tasankha ichi kuchokera ku makonda a msakatuli wanu.

/form/consent.v: Mukalembetsa, mukuvomera kulandira maimelo kuchokera kwa {sender}. Imelo iliyonse ili ndi ulalo wosiya kulembetsa.

/success/body.v: Tatumiza imelo yotsimikizira ku {email}. Itsegulani ndipo sankhani Tsimikizirani kulembetsa.

/success/next.v: Kope lanu loyamba lidzabwera mukatsimikizira, lolembedwa mu {language}.

/success/spam.v: Ngati palibe chomwe chafika pakatha mphindi zochepa, yang'anani mu foda ya spam kapena Promotions.

/errors/emailInvalid.v: Adilesi ya imelo iyi ikuoneka kuti siyokwanira. Ifufuzeni ndipo yesaninso.

/errors/missingLink.v: Ulalo wolembetsera uwu ulibe zambiri zokwanira. Pemphani ulalo watsopano kwa wotumiza.

/errors/notFound.v: Ulalo wolembetsera uwu sukugwiranso ntchito. Pemphani ulalo watsopano kwa wotumiza.

/errors/limit.v: Kalata yankhani iyi siingathe kulandira olembetsa atsopano pakadali pano. Yesaninso pambuyo pake.

/errors/invalid.v: Sitinathe kulandira adilesi iyi. Ifufuzeni ndipo yesaninso.

/errors/server.v: Sitinathe kusunga kulembetsa kwanu. Yesaninso pakapita kanthawi.

/errors/network.v: Sitinathe kufika pa seva. Fufuzani kulumikizana kwanu ndipo yesaninso.

/confirm/body.v: Sankhani batani kuti muyambe kulandira makope pa {email}.

/confirm/consent.v: Mukatsimikizira, mukuvomera kulandira kalata yankhani iyi pa imelo. Mutha kusiya kulembetsa kuchokera ku kope lililonse.

/confirm/successTip.v: Kuti asapite ku spam, onjezani wotumiza pa anthu omwe mumalumikizana nawo.

/confirm/invalidBody.v: Tsegulaninso imelo yotsimikizira ndipo sankhani batani lake. Ngati simukuipeza, lembetsaninso kuchokera patsamba la wotumiza.

/confirm/notFoundBody.v: Sitinapeze kulembetsa kwa adilesi iyi. Lembetsaninso kuchokera patsamba la wotumiza.

/confirm/errorBody.v: Sitinathe kutsimikizira kulembetsa kwanu. Yesaninso pakapita kanthawi.

/embed/title.v: Onjezani fomu yolembetsera pa tsamba lanu

/embed/intro.v: Matani imodzi mwa makhodi awa pa webusaiti yanu. Anthu omwe alembetsa amalandira imelo yotsimikizira, kenako makope anu m'chinenero chawo.

/embed/linkHint.v: Gawanani pa bio ya malo ochezera, siginecha ya imelo, kapena khodi ya QR.

/embed/scriptHint.v: Matani pamalo omwe fomu iyenera kuonekera. Fomu imasintha kukula kwake yokha.

/embed/iframeHint.v: Gwiritsani ntchito ichi ngati tsamba lanu siililola ma script.

/embed/accentHint.v: Musiyeni momwe ulili kuti mugwiritse ntchito mtundu wa chizindikiro chanu.

/embed/previewNote.v: Chiwonetserochi chikugwira ntchito kwenikweni. Kulembetsa pano kumapanga wolembetsa weniweni.

/embed/missing.v: Pangani kalata yankhani choyamba. Fomu yolembetsera idzaonekera pano ikakhalapo.

/signature/intro.v: Owerenga amaona izi kumapeto kwa kope lililonse. Dinani gawo lililonse la chiwonetsero kuti mulisinthe.

/signature/showHint.v: Mukaizimitsa, makope amatha pambuyo pa nkhani.

/signature/previewEmpty.v: Siginecha yanu ilibe kanthu. Onjezani dzina lanu kuti muyambe.

/signature/blocksHint.v: Sankhani chizindikiro kuti muonetse kapena kubisa gawolo. Magawo obisika amasunga mawu awo.

/signature/hints/photoUrl.v: Ulalo wa PNG kapena JPG yofanana mbali zonse, osachepera ma pixel 144 x 144 komanso pansi pa 200 KB. Imaonetsedwa pa ma pixel 72 x 72 pafupi ndi dzina lanu.

/signature/hints/logoUrl.v: Ulalo wa PNG kapena JPG yokhala ndi kumbuyo kowonekera kapena koyera, yosachepera ma pixel 64 kutalika. Imaonetsedwa pa kutalika kwa ma pixel 32.

/signature/hints/cta.v: Mawu ndi ulalo zonse zikufunika kuti batani lionekere.

/signature/hints/disclaimer.v: Mawu ang'onoang'ono pansi, mwachitsanzo chidziwitso chachinsinsi. Siyani lopanda kanthu ngati simukulifuna.

/signature/style/accentHint.v: Umagwiritsidwa ntchito pa mzere, maulalo ndi batani. Umayamba ndi mtundu wa chizindikiro chanu.
